end.summary:
Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi gave one unaided correct representation.
They counted examples including 13, 14, 16, 17, and 18.
They explained that one bundle contains ten, not one, in turn 9.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised building numbers with one bundle of ten and extra loose sticks or counters. Counting aloud helped them identify several numbers, and they explained that a bundle contains ten in turn 9. They mixed up counting the bundle as one with reading it as one ten; this was not fully corrected by the last example. At home, make one bundle of ten straws and add loose straws, then ask Saanvi to say both parts and the whole number.
